All five changes are in place in the isolated checkout, and the agreed proof command passes: **13 test files, 212 tests**. Nothing was committed or pushed. I did not run the app in a browser; the plan gives the browser checks to the host.

## Files I changed
The rest of `git status` is the host's imported snapshot.
- `src/bootcamps/conditionals/components/OpeningCourseContent.tsx` (main changes)
- `src/bootcamps/conditionals/components/MixedFamilyPractice.tsx` (new)
- `src/bootcamps/conditionals/components/OpeningCourseContent.test.tsx` (new, 6 tests)
- `src/bootcamps/conditionals/components/ConditionalReferenceSequence.tsx`: I only added `export` to `RuleDiagram`, `IncrementalWriter`, `targetExamples` and `TargetReader`.

## What changed in the lessons
1. **Must arrow:** now covers only the two sides, what "must" means, the raffle diagram built step by step, and a moved if-clause with its check.
   - The only / only-if comparison and its question moved to **Necessary-condition words**.
   - The required/requires "target can come before or after" pair moved to **Keep the whole meaning**. It replaces the editor-approval pair there, which made the same point.
   - The old stage-8 source is untouched, because the older lesson reader still uses it.
2. **Foundation lab:**
   - It keeps one raffle question ("Does the rule itself tell us that you actually win the raffle?").
   - The other three repeated questions are gone. In their place are fresh cases:
     - a market that moves indoors if it rains (two questions: before and after the fact arrives)
     - a school-trip permission slip (enough vs required)
     - a café that closes early (what stays open)
   - No arrows appear. Every choice has its own feedback and a "Try again" button. The delivery check and the possible-case question are kept.
3. **Mixed practice:**
   - Six new sentences alternate between the two word families (if, only if, every, required, the only, only).
   - Nothing tells the learner which family is coming. They pick the complete target, then which idea goes on the left, then check.
   - Feedback separately covers a target that drops a qualifier, the wrong idea, and a reversed arrow. The family is named only after the check.
   - "Next sentence" stays locked until the current sentence is checked, and answers are kept when moving back.
   - The existing Group 2 practice and the envelope exercise are kept, with the new set placed between them.
4. **Keep the whole meaning:** one short opening section explains the four checks, then four sections follow:
   - Check 1: target
   - Check 2: qualifications. The late applicant and current pass are now paired side by side, so the repeated heading is gone.
   - Check 3: only vs the only
   - Check 4: Personalized If/Then with the What Test
5. **Indicator notes:**
   - A line now invites the learner to work through all seven expressions.
   - A "Next expression: When" button moves focus to the next panel.
   - A status line reads "Expression 2 of 7 · 2 of 7 opened", and opened tabs get a ✓.
   - Learners can still pick any expression by hand, and their place is kept.
   - The flashcards sit after the examples with no lock and no claim of completion.

No routes, progress, assignment or completion code was touched, and no existing test was edited.

## Proof
- **First run:** two failures.
  - One of my new tests used the wrong button-name format. I fixed the test, not the code.
  - `ConditionalLessonNote.test.tsx` › "gives each formative choice its own reasoning…" ran past its 15-second limit. That test covers the older lesson reader, which I didn't change apart from adding exports. It passes alone in 13.7s and took 14.9s on the passing full run, so it will probably time out again under load.
- **Second run:** 13 files, 212 tests passed.
- **`npm run typecheck`:** clean.
- **ESLint on my files:** no errors, 5 warnings of the same kind the existing exports already produce.

## Blocked actions
- A command that chained several steps (to read `HOST-READY.md` and check git status) was denied. I read the marker with the file tools instead. It was there before I made any edits.
- A test re-run piped through `grep` was denied. I re-ran it without the filter.
- Writing `build-log.md` at the plan's LOG_FILE path was denied because it's outside the allowed folder, so that log does not exist. Its content is in this report.

## Deviations
- **Required/requires move:** I swapped it in for the editor-approval pair in Check 1 instead of adding it alongside, to avoid a duplicate block.
- **Group 2 practice:** I kept the existing Group 2 practice in the mixed-practice lab rather than removing it, because it is the only practice for the Group 2 expressions.

It passes alone (13.7 s) and took 14.9 s on the passing run. It covers the old reader path, which this build did not change.
- `npm run typecheck`: clean. ESLint on the changed files: 0 errors, 5 react-refresh warnings (same pattern as the existing exports).
